name: New York City
description: A high-energy metropolitan city known for art galleries, museums, parks, Broadway, and a bustling urban social scene.

name: Paris
description: A romantic historic city renowned for world-class museums, street cafes, fine dining, architecture, and scenic river cruises.

name: Tokyo
description: A curious blend of ancient temples and neon-lit modern technology, boasting sushi markets, beautiful gardens, and anime shopping.

name: Miami
description: A celebratory tropical destination famous for beach clubs, vibrant nightlife, and a relaxing sun-soaked social culture.

name: Grand Canyon
description: A peaceful and majestic geological marvel offering hiking trails, river rafting, sunset viewpoints, and nature tours.
